decision_rule: BUILT when listed edit 1 (run b) and listed edit 2 (run c) apply to the committed tdm.in and the dry-run deck is built from its lines; the originals are not edited.
metric: edited deck copies and the dry-run deck, with sha256 and unified diffs

prod_b_deleted_commands: compute         stressC   all centroid/stress/atom NULL pair bond angle dihedral improper
compute         stressK   all stress/atom NULL kspace
compute         fluxC     all heat/flux myKE myPE stressC
compute         redJkX all reduce sum v_JkXa
compute         redJkY all reduce sum v_JkYa
compute         redJkZ all reduce sum v_JkZa
fix             flux_raw all ave/time ${dump_every} 1 ${dump_every} v_Jtot_x v_Jtot_y v_Jtot_z file ${dump_dir}/HeatFlux_perstep_T${T}K_run${run_id}_seg${seg}.out
values.prod_b_diff:
--- tdm.in
+++ tdm_prod_b.in
@@ -41,23 +41,7 @@
 # heat current: centroid stress (pair+bonded) + kspace virial
 compute         TT        all temp
 compute         myP       all pressure TT
-compute         myKE      all ke/atom
-compute         myPE      all pe/atom
-compute         stressC   all centroid/stress/atom NULL pair bond angle dihedral improper
-compute         stressK   all stress/atom NULL kspace
-compute         fluxC     all heat/flux myKE myPE stressC
 
-variable        nktv2p_real equal 68568.415
-variable        JkXa atom -(c_stressK[1]*vx+c_stressK[4]*vy+c_stressK[5]*vz)/${nktv2p_real}
-variable        JkYa atom -(c_stressK[4]*vx+c_stressK[2]*vy+c_stressK[6]*vz)/${nktv2p_real}
-variable        JkZa atom -(c_stressK[5]*vx+c_stressK[6]*vy+c_stressK[3]*vz)/${nktv2p_real}
-compute         redJkX all reduce sum v_JkXa
-compute         redJkY all reduce sum v_JkYa
-compute         redJkZ all reduce sum v_JkZa
-
-variable        Jtot_x equal c_fluxC[1]+c_redJkX
-variable        Jtot_y equal c_fluxC[2]+c_redJkY
-variable        Jtot_z equal c_fluxC[3]+c_redJkZ
 
 variable        Pxx equal c_myP[1]
 variable        Pyy equal c_myP[2]
@@ -74,8 +58,6 @@
 # sample P-tensor & heat current every dump_every steps
 fix             stress_raw all ave/time ${dump_every} 1 ${dump_every} v_Pxx v_Pyy v_Pzz v_Pxy v_Pxz v_Pyz &
                 file ${dump_dir}/Stress_perstep_T${T}K_run${run_id}_seg${seg}.out
-fix             flux_raw all ave/time ${dump_every} 1 ${dump_every} v_Jtot_x v_Jtot_y v_Jtot_z &
-                file ${dump_dir}/HeatFlux_perstep_T${T}K_run${run_id}_seg${seg}.out
 
 thermo          ${thermo_every}
 thermo_style    custom step temp press density vol etotal
